cases.description: Return the number of nonempty chunks needed for count items at a positive chunk size, including any partial final chunk. Zero items require zero chunks.
Use the provided setting whenever it is not None, preserving explicit False, zero and empty strings; use the fallback only when the setting is None.
Select values between lower and upper inclusive, preserving input order and duplicates. An inverted interval selects nothing.
